title: Coin Collector
description: Collect falling coins as fast as you can to rack up points! Avoid missing coins and aim for the highest score.
how_to_play:
1. Press Enter to start the game.
2. Move the basket left and right using the arrow keys or joystick.
3. Catch the falling coins to earn points.
4. Missing coins will cost you points.
5. Try to beat your high score!

Tips:
- Focus on the coins above your basket.
- Move smoothly, don’t overreact to every coin.
- Try to chain catches for combos!
